sources.use: Independent check of world population total only; F01 Total tab gives 2025 mid-year population in thousands.

methodology.population: POP is summed across mutually exclusive L1 UC, UCL and RUR classes for each UNLocID. The 237-area sum differs from the rounded UN WUP2025 F01 World total by 6 persons (published precision).
methodology.landArea: landAreaKm2 is the sum of AREA_km2 over L1 UC, UCL and RUR classes. It is area assigned to Degree-of-Urbanisation classes, including open/unbuilt land inside those classes; it is not total legal/geographic national land area. Water and land outside the classified extent may be absent, so do not call the result total world land area or derive a world-land percentage from it.
methodology.builtUpArea: builtUpAreaKm2 is the sum of BU_km2 over the same classes. GHSL built-up surface counts roofed structures for any human use, including homes and non-residential buildings; it is not occupied housing area or total inhabited land, and it omits open/rural land without mapped structures.
methodology.aggregation: The 237 JRC rows are source country/area units. The world fields sum only those 237 rows, once per UNLocID. The five de facto rows have null stats and are excluded from all sums. The 248 current M49 rows plus Taiwan and Kosovo form the 250-row code-based roster; missing JRC stats stay null rather than being filled from a neighboring parent.
methodology.missingness: No 2025 JRC row means stats:null. M49 name/code rows remain present for roster completeness. Five additional de facto territories are scope-only and intentionally have null stats; each overlaps a listed parent jurisdiction.
